title: Lab - Init containers
description: Gate a Pod on an init step and debug it when it hangs.
scenario: Gate a Pod on an init step and debug it when it hangs. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Identify
tasks.instructions: Which Pods in the cluster have init containers and what do they run?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Add one
tasks.instructions: Add an init container to Pod red that runs `sleep 20` from busybox.
tasks.solution: # spec.initContainers: [{name: warm-up, image: busybox, command: [sleep, "20"]}]; replace --force
tasks.verification: kubectl get pod red  # Init:0/1 then Running

tasks.title: Task 3 - Stuck
tasks.instructions: Pod orange is stuck in Init. Find the bug in its init command and fix it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl logs orange -c init-myservice
# fix the typo (sleeeep -> sleep)
